property_summary: If a non-owner (the test contract is non-owner only if it isn't the deployer of C — but here test is deployer so we instead assert that calling withdraw(uint) with value greater than contract balance must revert and not change depositsCount or balance) — actually produce a rule: withdraw(uint) when called with a value greater than address(c).balance must revert (and therefore leave balance and depositsCount unchanged).
